Featured testimony

"I bought the hoodie for my son before he deployed. He wore it under his uniform. He came home and told me he read the verse on the tag every single night. I don't have words for what that shirt carried for him."

RCRenée C.Norfolk, VA · Collegiate Varsity hoodie
★★★★★

"Wore the Bold Graphic tee to a youth night and three kids asked where to get one. We ended up starting a Wednesday study group. Twelve strong now."

TWTyler W.Dallas, TX
★★★★★

"I've been sober fourteen months. The daily verse email is the first thing I read every morning. It's the anchor I didn't know I needed."

SBSamuel B.Portland, OR
★★★★★

"My mother passed in March. The prayer team emailed me every week for two months without me asking. That's not customer service, that's family."

ANAdaeze N.Houston, TX
★★★★★

"The hymns channel plays in our nursing home common room now. Residents who barely speak sing along to every word. Their families cry."

GHGrace H.Cedar Rapids, IA
★★★★★

"I'm the only believer in my family. Wearing something quiet but unmistakable makes Sunday dinners easier. It says what I can't always say out loud."

KLKim L.San Jose, CA
★★★★★

"Ordered ten tees for our mission trip to Guatemala. The give-back funded a well in the village we visited. We drank from it. That's a full circle."

MPMicah P.Boise, ID
★★★★★

"I run a barbershop. Left the 90s channel on for a month and now half my chairs open with a prayer. Never advertised it. It just happened."

DTDevon T.Atlanta, GA
★★★★★

"My daughter is nine and picked out the Y2K tee herself. She memorized the verse on the label before I did. Kids catch what we hand them."

AFAlicia F.Tampa, FL
★★★★★

"Lost my job in January. Called the prayer number expecting voicemail. A man named Elias prayed with me for twenty minutes. I start a new role Monday."

JOJoel O.Newark, NJ

The prayer line

We're here to pray for you.

There is no request too small and no situation too far gone. Our prayer team is made up of volunteers from a dozen churches who take turns covering the line, and every request that comes in is prayed over by name — not filed, not automated, not forgotten.

Call us and speak to someone directly, or send the form below and we'll write back within a day. Ask us to keep it private and we will. Ask us to keep praying and we'll check in every week until you tell us to stop.

☎Call the prayer line1-855-572-9247Answered 7am–11pm CT · voicemail prayed over nightly ✉Email the teamprayer@loveandloveyah.comA real reply within 24 hours

Send a prayer request

Fill in what you're comfortable sharing. Nothing here is required except the request itself.

What is this about?
How it works
Your request reaches three team members. One prays and replies personally. Nothing is shared outside the team without your permission.
Live prayer calls
Tuesdays and Thursdays, 7:00pm CT on the radio's Morning Prayer channel. Call in or just listen.
Emergencies
We are not a crisis service. If you are in danger or thinking of harming yourself, call or text 988 first — then call us. We'll still be here.
